data.one_liner: Display formatted rich text using simple characters like asterisks and slashes.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to style text easily by using standard characters like asterisks for bold and slashes for italics. It also supports colors and basic navigation attributes via curly brackets.
use_when: You want a low-friction way to add inline bold, italics, underlines, and colors to strings.
You want simple text-based hyperlinks that interact with the navigation stack.
avoid_when: You need user-definable custom formatting callback functions.
strengths: Very low development friction compared to traditional RichText or pattern-matching packages.
Supports basic routing and color configurations inline using curly brackets.
weaknesses: Non-standard formatting characters that are not markdown-compatible.
Lacks user-definable format characters and custom formatting callbacks.
data.setup_notes: Ancestor must have textDirection set explicitly or through MaterialApp.
